name: swapwallet
description: SwapWallet crypto wallet in Codex: balances, P&L and history, plus swaps, transfers and withdrawals that run only after you approve them in Telegram.

interface.shortDescription: Your SwapWallet crypto account, with Telegram approval for every money move.
interface.longDescription: Read balances, profit and loss, transaction history and deposit addresses from your SwapWallet account, and request swaps, transfers and withdrawals. No tool moves money by itself: each request is priced and sent to your Telegram, and runs only after you approve it there. Connects to SwapWallet's hosted MCP server over OAuth 2.1.
defaultPrompt: Show my profit and loss on BTC and TON.
